{{Top|leg}}
'''Gamma flux broilers''' were cooking devices. Presumably, they used [[Gamma ray/Legends|gamma]] [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] to heat food. During Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] captivity by [[Thalassa Tarkin|Lady Tarkin]], the Lady ordered Leia to monitor her villa's gamma flux broilers during a banquet.
